Full summary: Housekeeping executed on beta.2 via stdio runner: 7 superseded_by back-links written (0 dangling), 1 pre-1.24 loop-junk archive entry dropped (~1.2 KB), 73 entries archived, 2 orphaned graph entities pruned. First execute-mode run of both new v2.0 passes on live state — clean.
Findings: Execute-vs-preview discrepancy worth a look: preview reported deduplicated.removed=10, execute reported 0 — the intervening auto-archive pass (73 entries) appears to have absorbed the duplicates before dedup ran. Not a bug in the new passes, but pass-ordering makes preview counts non-binding for dedup; could confuse users comparing preview to execute.
